finding.text: The compaction cost was measured on an older nudge compaction (158k → 17k, $0.24), not on a compaction this new hook triggered. That is fine as "the cost of one compaction" (ask 3), but the first real `why: "sleep"` line after the restart should be checked against it — Servex/doc/dormant.md, "Measured cost".

An agent that goes to sleep and never wakes again pays for its compaction for nothing (about $0.24 at 158k). The doc says "one compaction pays for itself at the first wake", and that only holds when there is a wake. Worth one line in dormant.md; one-pass roles are stopped rather than slept (Agents.js:2041), so they are not affected.

After a compaction, the dormant log line records `after: 0` (Agents.js:2120, `mark_slept(this, 0)`), though the agent really waited its idle time plus the compaction. That makes the log read as if the agent slept instantly; passing the real wait would make it accurate.
Ask 6 ("log ready: <branch> <sha>" and "needs restart") is not in the diff and could not be checked here. The two commits 16943da65 and 95927b66c are in place.
The diff also fixes something nobody asked for: `rss_mb = null` after a memory restart (Agents.js:2117). It is small, has its own test and is documented, so it can stay.

The role reminder says "Your full role text is in your system prompt", but `Agent.reminder_text()` (Servex/agents/Agents.js, `reminder_text`) does not check `this.system` or `SERVEX_ROLE_IN_SYSTEM=0`. So an agent with its own `spec.system` (the voice pair, the directory mastermind), or one running with the off switch, is told something that is not true. Fix: return null when `this.system` is set, or reword the line when `role_prompt()` is null.

`role_prompt()` also applies when an agent resumes (`this.resume`). An old session that already has the role readme in its first message now gets it a second time in the system prompt, and its first resume after the restart writes the whole cache cold, because the system prompt changed from `[""]` to the claude_code preset. This is a one-time cost. context-drift.md mentions "a few thousand cached tokens per agent" but does not mention this cold write.

Switching every plain spawn from the empty system prompt to the claude_code preset changes how every Servex agent behaves at once (Claude Code's guidance on tools, git and safety), not only its role text. context-drift.md says so honestly. Watch the first few agents after the restart: the off switch is `SERVEX_ROLE_IN_SYSTEM=0`.

The compaction cost (ask 3) was measured on an older nudge compaction (158k → 17k, $0.24, 61 s), not on one this new hook triggered. Check the first real `compact` line with `why: "sleep"` against it after the restart.

The previous review's note 3 is fixed. `compact_done` now passes the real wait to `mark_slept` (`g.wait_ms?.(this) ?? 0`). Ask 6 ("ready: <branch> <sha>" and "needs restart") is a log step outside the diff, and this review cannot check it. The branch head is 993af2c9d.
